modelDescriptionsDesc.zh: 在一级列表中显示模型的简短说明。
modelDescriptionsDesc.en: Show short model descriptions in the primary list.

modelOrderDesc.zh: 服务商分组内的排列方式；「自定义」读取配置文件中的 modelOrderRows。
modelOrderDesc.en: Order within each provider group; Custom reads modelOrderRows from the config file.

teamDescription.zh: 通过共享任务板协调多个智能体的分工与进度，适合复杂任务，Token 消耗也会相应增加。
teamDescription.en: Coordinates multiple agents on a shared task board for complex work, using more tokens.

teamUnavailable.zh: 智能体团队协作服务未就绪

teamFailed.zh: 无法确认智能体团队协作设置已保存，请重试：{message}
teamFailed.en: Could not confirm the agent teamwork setting was saved. Try again: {message}

teamDisableTitle.zh: 确认停用智能体团队协作？

teamDisableDescription.zh: 对话过程中停用智能体团队协作，将停止共享任务工具和团队协调指令。
teamDisableDescription.en: Disabling agent teamwork during a conversation stops shared task tools and team coordination instructions.

teamDisableWarning.zh: 停用后可能影响缓存复用、增加后续 Token 用量与开销，并影响当前任务的协作效果。
teamDisableWarning.en: Disabling it may reduce cache hits, increase subsequent token usage and affect collaboration on the current task.

pluginPaneUnsupported.zh: 当前模型选择器无法直接打开此项设置面板，请先关闭「重绘模型选择器」后操作。
pluginPaneUnsupported.en: This option opens a native model-menu settings pane. Turn off Model picker restyle first to open it.
